## Who this is
**Al Andrew Paul Beltran** (often **Al Beltran**, online brand **Code by Pawpu**) is a **Senior Software Engineer** based in **Manila, Philippines**. He currently works as a **Software Engineer at Google via High Spring**. He is the **founder of Momentra Labs**. He builds **full-stack** and **event-driven** software, with strong experience in **React**, **Node.js**, **Java**, **AWS** (serverless, SQS/SNS/Lambda, Step Functions), and **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** for enterprise platforms.
